item.title: Wildfire risk assessment, 16th August
item.description:
Following the Government wildfire alert on Friday 14 August, I am concerned about the potential wildfire risk to our flats from the woodland directly behind them. I do not know whether there is currently a problem with the woodland, but given the very high wildfire risk recently and the proximity of the trees and vegetation to our homes, I would like to request that the area is inspected to establish whether there are any issues that could increase the risk of fire spreading to the properties, and whether any preventative measures may be needed. Please could you also confirm who is responsible for this woodland?
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Waratah Drive, Elmstead, Greater London
